_comment: Merged into ~/.codex/hooks.json by /deploy-global (step 13). PreToolUse gates `apply_patch` — the first patch authoring a file a rule scopes is denied with a short reason naming the rule file — and `Bash` ONLY for a patch written through the shell (`*** Add File:` headers author files too). PostToolUse observes `Bash`: Codex has no read tool, so a completed `cat`/`sed`/`head` of the rule file is the only way the gate is ever released. HIVE_HARNESS=codex selects the ~/.agents reference root and the wide reason budget (Codex carries 24 KB, so one denial names every pending rule).
